Our platform connects frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity. Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly-Clark, Scott Miracle-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations. Our customers have achieved $50M+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10× improvement in frontline productivity , and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs. Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in Frost & Sullivan's “Frost Radar 2025 -  Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by Vista Equity Partners and Tiger Global Management . With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR. The Role As a Visual Designer on the Product Marketing team, you will produce every high-visibility visual asset Innovapptive puts in front of buyers — from executive sales decks and event keynotes to booth graphics, ad creative, and customer proof visuals. You will own design end-to-end and bring an executive-grade, B2B-enterprise sensibility to everything you create. This is a hands-on role for a fast, versatile designer who can take rough notes, messy slides, or verbal direction and turn them into polished, final-quality output independently. With a busy event calendar and ongoing campaign production, turnaround speed matters. A strong portfolio of B2B presentation design, sales collateral, or event work is mandatory to apply. How You Will Make an Impact Sales & Executive Presentations: Design and produce all sales decks, pitch presentations, and executive decks end-to-end to executive-grade standard, and build executive keynotes for events, webinars, partner sessions, and C-suite presentations. Event & Booth Design: Design booth graphics and event signage — concept through print-ready production files. Advertising Creative: Create ad creatives for Linked In, display advertising, and partner co-marketing campaigns. Video Production: Own end-to-end video production, including Canva-based video creation and general video assets. Responsibilities include editing OWT / product videos, trimming, adding lower thirds, title cards, captions, and basic motion. Landing Page & Web Visuals: Design landing page visual elements — hero graphics, section graphics, proof visuals, icons, and CTA graphics. Data & Proof Visualisation: Create ROI infographics and value visualisations for case studies, proof decks, and customer-facing materials, plus competitive comparison visuals, battlecard layouts, and positioning framework graphics. Templates & Brand Consistency: Build reusable design templates — sales deck master, case study layout, event deck template, proof-point cards — and maintain brand consistency across all product marketing, event, outbound, and campaign materials. Independent Execution: Take rough PMM notes, messy slides, or verbal direction and produce polished, final-quality output independently. What You Bring to the Team Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field; equivalent portfolio experience also considered. 2+ years in B2B design — in-house marketing team, Saa S company, or B2B-focused design agency. Proficient in Canva (advanced) — can build at speed without losing quality or brand consistency. Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite — Illustrator and Photoshop at minimum; Premiere or After Effects a strong plus. Strong Google Slides and Power Point skills — can build executive-grade presentations from scratch, not just edit templates. Understands B2B design language — clean, data-rich, and professional; knows the difference between B2B enterprise and consumer/lifestyle aesthetics. Video editing capability — can cut, add graphics, and caption OWT or product demo recordings. Fast turnaround under real deadline pressure — can deliver same-day when event and sales deadlines demand it. Strong portfolio showing B2B presentation design, sales collateral, or event design work — mandatory to apply. Nice to Have Motion graphics or animation experience (After Effects, Canva video, or similar). Figma experience for landing page mockups or design-system work. Experience designing for trade show, physical event, or booth environments. Background in enterprise software, industrial technology, or a manufacturing/operations design context. Ability to achieve quick turnaround on visual design using AI-powered tools. Experience: 2+ years — young talent welcome; portfolio is non-negotiable. What Success Looks Like — First 90 Days Reusable sales deck master template and case study slide template completed. 2–3 executive sales decks redesigned to executive-grade quality. Event graphic assets delivered without the Product Marketing Lead doing first-pass design. Standard visual library built — proof-point cards, value framework templates, competitive comparison layouts. Turnaround time for PMM visual assets reduced; the Lead no longer producing first-pass design work.
